The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust DBA approach may outperform simple weighted.
Test a simple mean of the full pool to see if a robust unweighted average beats weighted inverse-error given unstable ranking.
The series has unstable ranking (tau=0.166) and strong trend; a robust median of the full pool may outperform weighted.
test a robust softmax weighting on the full pool to see if a less aggressive weighting improves over inverse_error given unstable ranking.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean over the full pool may mitigate outliers and correlation groups.
test a per‑horizon weighted scheme (top‑k mean per horizon) on the full pool to see if adapting to horizon shifts improves robustness for this trend‑dominated series.
inverse error weighting on the full pool

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.6908. Series context: trend strength 0.9676 and seasonal strength 0.2925; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.166); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 11.916.
